# Get started

Learn the key things you'll need to do when getting started with Fundraise Up, as well as creative guidelines, embedding instructions, and more.

Fundraise Up is an innovative web-based platform that makes it easy for nonprofits to accept donations and increase giving. With powerful features, Fundraise Up makes it simple for your organization to create and manage successful fundraising campaigns.

## Where to start

Ready to get started with Fundraise Up? If you already have an account, we recommend exploring the [onboarding guide](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/onboarding/), which will guide you through a ten-step account setup process.

If you don’t yet have a Fundraise Up account, [contact our sales team](https://fundraiseup.com/contact-sales) to learn about the account options that are right for your organization.

## Features

Fundraise Up comprises seven core features designed to optimize the donor experience and unlock additional revenue for your organization.

### Campaigns

Create Campaigns in 25 different languages for each of your key fundraising activities, and take advantage of our powerful Checkout form for each one, whether its in the form of a modal overlay or a hosted Campaign Page. Fundraise Up’s Checkout experience enables donation ask personalization using AI, includes upsell tools to boost recurring giving and overall revenue, and provides turnkey support for modern payment methods. Built with advanced fraud protection and encryption technology, our Campaigns provides your organization with an encrypted and secure solution for online giving. [Learn more →](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/fundraise/)

### Elements

Elements is a library of UI components designed specifically for fundraisers and nonprofit marketers. Using Elements, you can add buttons, sliders, progress bars, and other engaging features to your existing website — no coding required. Learn more →

### Payment methods

Offer popular payment methods that increase conversion. Fundraise Up offers turnkey activation for cards, wallets, bank and crypto. [Learn more →](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/payment-methods/)

### Donor Portal

Donor Portal is a self-service dashboard where your supporters can view and manage their donations and fundraisers. Optimized for retention, Donor Portal includes features that reduce the chances of supporters cancelling their recurring plans. [Learn more →](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/donor-portal/)

### Languages

Reach a global audience or optimize giving for supporters within your region. Using Fundraise Up, you can localize your donor experience into 25 languages, so supporters around the world can give in a language they read. Learn more →

### Integrations

Sync donations from Fundraise Up to virtually any other app using built-in integrations for Salesforce, Zapier, and more than 10 other platforms. [Learn more →](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/analyze/)

Region-specific features:Fundraise Up supports region-specific payment methods, languages, receipting requirements, regulatory compliances, and data residency mandates. [Learn more →](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/region-specific/)

## Pricing model

Fundraise Up uses performance-based pricing: instead of upfront, setup, or subscription fees, you pay a fee on each donation processed through the platform. Supporters can choose to cover this fee when they donate, which brings the effective cost to around 1% on average.

Fundraise Up pricing at a glance:

- Performance-based.
- $0 upfront.
- No setup or subscription fees.
- No long-term contracts.
- Around 1% average effective cost after fee coverage.

## Support

Fundraise Up offers free, 24/7 email support to all customers. Customers with a Custom Account may have access to additional support resources, as described below.

For questions or general inquiries, [email our support team](mailto:support@fundraiseup.com).

## Technical information

The information below outlines key technical details about the Fundraise Up platform.

### Browser compatibility

Fundraise Up supports the following minimum browser versions.

#### **Supporter-facing components**

Including Checkout Modal, Campaign Pages, Elements, Donor Portal, and other supporter-facing experiences.

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| Safari | 15.6 |
| Chrome/Edge | 120 |
| Firefox | 121 |

#### **Dashboard**

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| Safari | 16.6 |
| Chrome/Edge | 130 |
| Firefox | 131 |

Other browsers may be compatible with Fundraise Up, but they are not officially supported.

#### In-app browsers

Fundraise Up’s Checkout modal, Campaign Page and other platform features are compatible with in-app browsers, but some [payment options](https://fundraiseup.com/support/app-browsers/) may not be visible during the donation process because of app or device limitations.

### Processing capacity

Fundraise Up is capable of processing and validating up to 600 real-time transactions per second. This capacity can be scaled to 1,000 transactions per second on high-volume days such as GivingTuesday and December 31st.

## Legal

Below, you will find information about how we protect your privacy, what you can and cannot do with Fundraise Up, and how we handle organization accounts.

- [Terms of Service](https://fundraiseup.com/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://fundraiseup.com/privacy)

For legal inquiries, [email us](mailto:legal@fundraiseup.com).

### Data processing addendum

A Data Processing Addendum (DPA) is an agreement between Fundraise Up and its customers that outlines the responsibilities of each party in relation to the processing of personal data. The DPA outlines the appropriate security measures that must be taken to protect the personal data of supporters and other stakeholders. The DPA is designed to ensure that Fundraise Up complies with all applicable data protection laws and regulations.

To request a signed copy of the existing DPA between Fundraise Up and your organization, or to request a signature of a new one, please email [legal@fundraiseup.com](mailto:legal@fundraiseup.com).
